title: Listen together
description: Plays a folder of audio for everyone at the same moment: the owner starts, pauses and skips from the toolbar (no need to start the control first), listeners follow by the service's clock, with a running waveform and the lyrics of a song that has a .lrc file of the same name. Anyone can listen on their own for a while; their volume and their own position are kept for them.
